article.title: America loves free speech, except when it comes to Palestine
article.author: Mitchell Plitnick
article.content: Whether it’s Macklemore, Hasan Piker, or your neighborhood activist, this is a fight to make sure billionaires and politicians cannot stop free speech and will have to hear the calls to “Free Palestine” whether they like it or not.
